@graph.howPerformed: After a consultation and skin assessment, the treatment area is cleansed and a conductive gel is applied. Focused ultrasound energy is then delivered to the targeted areas to stimulate collagen production. Moisturizer and sunscreen are applied afterwards, along with aftercare guidance. Any mild redness or tingling usually settles within hours.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients feel mild discomfort, but it's generally well tolerated. Our specialists can discuss options to make you more comfortable.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your goals and the areas treated. Many people see results after one session.

mainEntity.name: How long do the results last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results can last up to 12–18 months with proper skincare and maintenance.

mainEntity.name: Can HIFU replace a surgical facelift?

acceptedAnswer.text: HIFU gives noticeable improvement, but it may not match a surgical facelift. It's a good non-invasive alternative for mild to moderate sagging.
